install_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends msmtp msmtp-mta ca-certificates python3 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
auth_script:
rm -f /tmp/.msmtprc
cat > /tmp/.msmtprc <<EOF
account default
host $SMTP_HOST
port $SMTP_PORT
auth on
user $SMTP_USER
password $SMTP_PASSWORD
tls on
tls_starttls on
from $SMTP_FROM
EOF
chmod 600 /tmp/.msmtprc
cat > /tmp/send-attachment <<'PYEOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os, sys, smtplib, argparse
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email import encoders

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--to', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--subject', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--body')
parser.add_argument('--body-file')
parser.add_argument('--attach', action='append', default=[])
args = parser.parse_args()

smtp_host = os.environ['SMTP_HOST']
smtp_port = int(os.environ['SMTP_PORT'])
smtp_user = os.environ['SMTP_USER']
smtp_pass = os.environ['SMTP_PASSWORD']
smtp_from = os.environ['SMTP_FROM']

msg = MIMEMultipart()
msg['From'] = smtp_from
msg['To'] = args.to
msg['Subject'] = args.subject

body = ''
if args.body_file:
    with open(args.body_file) as f:
        body = f.read()
elif args.body:
    body = args.body
msg.attach(MIMEText(body, 'plain'))

for path in args.attach:
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        part = MIMEBase('application', 'octet-stream')
        part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header('Content-Disposition', f'attachment; filename="{os.path.basename(path)}"')
    msg.attach(part)

with smtplib.SMTP(smtp_host, smtp_port) as s:
    s.starttls()
    s.login(smtp_user, smtp_pass)
    s.sendmail(smtp_from, args.to, msg.as_string())
    print(f'Email sent to {args.to} ({len(args.attach)} attachment(s))')
PYEOF
chmod +x /tmp/send-attachment
skill_content:
# Sending Email (SMTP)

Two helpers are available:

- **`msmtp`** — plain text email via the system SMTP client. Configured at `/tmp/.msmtprc` (NOT `~/.msmtprc` because the container's home directory is not writable). Always invoke with `msmtp -C /tmp/.msmtprc` so it picks up the config.
- **`/tmp/send-attachment`** — Python helper for **MIME multipart** messages with **file attachments**.

Both read SMTP credentials from environment variables (`SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASSWORD`, `SMTP_FROM`) which are injected from the bound credential.

## Plain text email (msmtp)

```bash
# Simple body
echo -e "Subject: Hello\n\nThis is the body." | msmtp -C /tmp/.msmtprc recipient@example.com

# With headers and multiple recipients (use -t to read recipients from headers)
cat <<EOF | msmtp -C /tmp/.msmtprc -t
To: alice@example.com, bob@example.com
Cc: manager@example.com
Subject: Status Update

All tasks complete.
EOF

# Send a file as the body
(echo "Subject: Log Output"; echo; cat /tmp/output.log) | msmtp -C /tmp/.msmtprc recipient@example.com
```

## Email with attachments (send-attachment)

```bash
# Single attachment
/tmp/send-attachment \
  --to recipient@example.com \
  --subject "Weekly report" \
  --body "Please find this week's report attached." \
  --attach reports/weekly.pdf

# Body from a file (e.g. raw markdown)
/tmp/send-attachment \
  --to admin@example.com \
  --subject "Weekly Security Report" \
  --body-file reports/weekly.md \
  --attach reports/weekly.pdf

# Multiple attachments — repeat --attach
/tmp/send-attachment \
  --to ops@example.com \
  --subject "Daily artifacts" \
  --body "Three artifacts attached." \
  --attach build.log \
  --attach metrics.json \
  --attach screenshot.png
```

## Notes

- Both helpers live in `/tmp` because the container's home directory and `/usr/local/bin` are not writable inside sandbox jobs.
- `send-attachment` uses `STARTTLS` on the configured SMTP port (typically 587). For SES this is `email-smtp.<region>.amazonaws.com:587`.
- The body is sent as `text/plain`. To send HTML, use `msmtp` with a manually constructed `Content-Type: text/html` header, or extend `send-attachment` (it's just a Python script you can copy and modify).
- Errors go to stderr; check the worker logs if mail fails.

env_vars.description: SMTP server port. Use 587 for STARTTLS (recommended).
